status_definitions.open: Not decided or not sufficiently tested.
status_definitions.supported_internal: Supported by analysis or experiments produced inside this repository.
status_definitions.mixed_internal: Internal evidence contains both support and material counterevidence.
status_definitions.contradicted_internal: Weakened or contradicted by evidence produced inside this repository.
status_definitions.supported_external: Supported by an identified independent replication.
status_definitions.falsified: A preregistered falsification condition was met.
status_definitions.decision: Governance or product decision; not an empirical finding.

replication_definitions.executable: Executable code exists but the result is not pinned by the quick reproduction protocol.
replication_definitions.independent: Reproduced by an independent party or implementation.

claims.statement: Edge-level historization plus revisit handling escapes the repository's designed cycle and trap domains more reliably than memoryless greedy.
claims.scope: Designed gridworld, domain-invariance, and falsification domains in this repository; not arbitrary graph navigation.
limitations: Domains and implementations were designed by the same project.
Memoryless greedy is intentionally weak on cycle traps.
No independent replication is recorded.

last_verified.result: Quick reproduction passed 8/8 claims; targeted baseline tests passed in the same run before sandbox-only tmp_path setup errors in unrelated persistence tests.

claims.statement: Historization is the dominant generally useful mechanism in E0 and should be the primary product surface.
claims.scope: Cross-mechanism product value, not merely success on designed trap domains.

sources.role: WP-2.4 full-budget development comparison against fair baselines

limitations: The '6x confirmed' count has no six-item independent evidence mapping.
River City contains a stale-memory case where historization hurts.
No independent adoption or replication establishes general product value.

Mechanism dominance within E0 is now measured by the WP-2.4 causal ablation (all five variants score identically), but that same run shows A_HIST below the fair baseline median in three of four development families and below uniform random overall; the advantage concentrates in wall_grid.

last_verified.result: Within E0, historization dominance is confirmed: the WP-2.4 ablation scores all five E0 variants identically and A_HIST is the fastest. External competitiveness is contradicted at development level in three of four preregistered families.

claims.statement: On the preregistered E0-G1-v1 development split, historization-only A_HIST is not competitive with the per-instance median of fairly trained Q-learning, UCB1-edge, and random-restart-greedy: overall success-adjusted efficiency 0.208 versus 0.407 (paired difference -0.199, 95% CI [-0.206, -0.192], goal rate -27.8pp), with only wall_grid qualifying under the preregistered family criteria (+0.260, 95% CI [+0.248, +0.272]).
claims.scope: WP-2.4 development seeds 0-9 only; 1,560 replicates over four families, three scales, and 13 methods from GitHub Actions run 30526724307. Development diagnostic, explicitly not a Gate-G1 result; the holdout remains unopened.

sources.role: retained provenance, diagnostics, criteria application, and consequences
machine-readable diagnostics derived solely from raw_runs.jsonl

limitations: Development seeds only; the preregistered gate is defined on the unopened holdout.
Four designed synthetic families at N in {100, 500, 1000}; no real-world domain.
A_HIST still beats memoryless greedy and epsilon-greedy, and wins wall_grid clearly; non-competitiveness is family-dependent, not uniform.
Uniform random outscoring A_HIST overall reflects the low goal rates of the designed families for edge-local methods.
required_next_evidence: RESOLVED 2026-08-05: the user chose closure; G1-v1 is closed on development evidence with the holdout permanently unopened (E0-GATE-G1-CLOSURE-001).
Repositioning documents trade-offs against these baselines instead of superiority claims (WP-5.1).

last_verified.result: Bundle SHA-256 values verified against the in-artifact manifest after download; 1,560/1,560 replicates complete with zero infrastructure failures; diagnostics read from summary.json unchanged.

development evidence the decision rests on

claims.statement: In the reported C185 grid-city setup, the conservative overlay at confidence 0.85 improved completed trips by about 4.2% to 6% over E0 greedy, while confidence 0.5 was worse.
claims.scope: C185 5x4 traffic simulation with 10 and 20 vehicles and the report's fixed configuration.
limitations: The main 4.2%-6% result is tied to one synthetic topology family and fixed simulator design.
No committed machine-readable raw result artifact exists.
The experiment does not isolate phase from lookahead, path aggregation, or gating.
River City produces negative historization and overlay cases at other congestion levels.

last_verified.result: Report and executable inspected; result not promoted beyond its original scope.

claims.statement: The practical advantage attributed to the amplitude overlay is caused by phase interference rather than by lookahead, path aggregation, or confidence gating.
claims.scope: The preregistered E0-G1-v1 development distribution; no claim that phase is impossible in every constructed field.

sources.role: overlay result without phase-free causal control
warning that typical tested regimes can remain constructive
preregistered measurement design executed on the full development split
machine-readable full-episode aggregate and bounded decision probe

limitations: The completed evidence is development-only; protected holdout seeds remain unread.
All 4,482,410 persisted D decisions remained in the gradient regime, so E0-G1-v1 did not sample an operationally phase-active regime.
C331 contradicts a practical phase advantage in the G1-v1 distribution but does not prove phase interference is impossible in every constructed domain.
required_next_evidence: Close E0-G1-v1 as development-negative without spending its holdout, or record an explicit E0-G1-v2 amendment.
Any G1-v2 must use a separate calibration split, preregister phase-excitation checks, and create fresh protected holdout seeds.

last_verified.result: Development contradicted practical phase attribution: D-vs-C mean difference 0.0; zero overrides; all D decisions gradient.

claims.statement: In the constructed C319 examples, typical weights produce mostly constructive phase aggregation; outright cancellation appears only after the measured phase gap enters a wrapped regime.
claims.scope: Fields and weight sweeps implemented in lean/structural_geometry; not a representative survey of operational domains.
limitations: The examples are constructed, not sampled from a preregistered domain population.
The result weakens broad cancellation language but does not prove cancellation is absent in all useful domains.

last_verified.result: Acceptance suite included in targeted run.

claims.scope: Greedy controller with historization and revisit handling; not the amplitude/path-family layer.

The full benchmark is synthetic and does not exercise amplitude path enumeration.
No independent implementation or external workload is recorded.

claims.statement: At N = 100, 500, and 1000, the remediated amplitude/path-family layer is executable at full development scale, but it shows no practical advantage over the selected simpler control.
claims.scope: The complete E0-G1-v1 development matrix: 120 instances x 13 methods, with holdout unread.

sources.role: existing scaling benchmark explicitly covers historization/revisit controller, not amplitude
C330 scaling repair and local parity evidence
C331 result interpretation and neutralization boundary

limitations: Three E_FULL_GEOMETRY wall_grid N=1000 replicates remained valid algorithmic timeouts.

required_next_evidence: Record the E0-G1-v1 lifecycle decision without reading holdout.
If research continues, define and preregister a fresh E0-G1-v2 with an independently calibrated action gate and phase-active development domains.

last_verified.result: Full development execution completed: 1557/1560 regular completions, 3 algorithmic timeouts, 0 infrastructure failures, 0 path-cap hits, and no E-vs-control benefit.
